channel.title: Boulder Daily Camera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Crocs stock price kicks up after shoemaker unveils earnings, cost-saving effort
item.description: Crocs Inc.’s (Nasdaq: CROX) stock price spiked Thursday after the Broomfield-based casual footwear company reported financials for what it called a “better-than-expected” fourth quarter.

item.title: Sandoval moves to Bank of Colorado
item.description: Bonifacio “Boni” Sandoval, who has 37 years of banking experience in Colorado and who most recently served as senior vice president for commercial banking at Adams Bank and Trust, began Jan. 26 as a commercial loan officer at Bank of Colorado.

item.title: Trimble revenues down in fourth quarter, fiscal 2025
item.description: Trimble Inc. (Nasdaq: TRMB), a Westminster-based industrial-technology company, posted lower year-over-year sales totals in the fourth quarter of 2025 and for the full fiscal year but outperformed analysts’ expectations.

item.title: Levi’s, Earthbound Trading Co. among new shops coming to Flatiron Crossing
item.description: BROOMFIELD — Flatiron Crossing owner Macerich Co. will add a handful of clothing and home goods retailers in 2026.

item.title: Michelin Guide expanding to include all of Colorado
item.description: The Michelin Guide, which debuted in Colorado in 2023 and has thus far only featured restaurants in Boulder, Denver, Aspen and Vail, will expand its coverage in future editions to include the whole state.

item.title: TriSalus Life Sciences swaps board members
item.description: Arjun Desai has stepped down from the board of directors at TriSalus Life Sciences Inc. (Nasdaq: TLSI), a Westminster-based oncology company, and is being replaced by Michael Stansky.

item.title: Integral Consulting acquires California firm
item.description: BOULDER — Integral Consulting Inc., an environmental, scientific, and engineering consulting firm, recently acquired H. T. Harvey & Associates, a California-based ecological consulting firm.

item.title: JumpCloud launches investment arm
item.description: JumpCloud Inc., an IT access-management platform, recently launched JumpCloud Ventures, an investment arm that the Louisville firm says “will support early-stage companies building identity, security, AI, and IT productivity solutions.”

item.title: Annie and Millie’s Place hires new leader
item.description: Annie and Millie’s Place, a Longmont nonprofit organization that provides services for homeless people and their pets, has hired Cliff Cullen as its new executive director.

item.title: Boulder’s Wonderland Creek Townhomes trades for $23M+
item.description: Seattle-based real estate investor Timberlane Partners recently bought Wonderland Creek Townhomes, a 41-unit community at 3701 Paseo del Prado in Boulder, for $23.25 million.
